articles.summary: LOS ANGELES – September 15, 2026 – ServiceTitan (Nasdaq: TTAN), the software platform that powers the trades, today announced that Canopy Services, a residential roofing platform backed by Trivest Partners, has standardized operations on ServiceTitan to support continued growth across its expanding family of roofing brands. By bringing sales, production, customer management, and reporting onto a single platform, Canopy has established a repeatable operating model that enables growth while preserving the local expertise and customer relationships that define each brand.
articles.title: ServiceTitan Powers Canopy Services Growth Across the Roofing Industry
